svg.aria-label: Animation: Dijkstra's algorithm settling nodes in cost order and relaxing edges to find a shortest path
svg.title: Animation: Dijkstra's algorithm settling nodes in cost order and relaxing edges to find a shortest path
svg.text: Cheapest first, not nearest first: a greedy choice that provably holds
edges now have costs, so fewest hops no longer means cheapest. Always settle the nearest unsettled node next.

g.text: every distance starts at infinity except the source. Settle A, then relax its edges: B = 4, C = 2.
pick the cheapest unsettled node - C at 2, not B at 4. Relax: E = 2+3 = 5, F = 2+8 = 10.
settle B at 4 and relax D = 9. Through B, E would cost 4+10 = 14 - worse than 5, so 5 stands.
settle E at 5 and relax G = 5+6 = 11
D would give G 13 and F would give 12 - both lose. Shortest path A-C-E-G, total cost 11.
a settled distance is final - which is exactly why Dijkstra breaks on negative edge weights
